newsitem.title: USA: Shells Seafood to add restaurants in H2.
newsitem.headline: Shells Seafood to add restaurants in H2.

text.p: Shells Seafood Restaurants Inc said it plans to open new restaurants in Florida and the Midwest in the second half of the year.
Shells said second-quarter net for the 13 week second quarter ended June 29, 1997 increased 58 percent to $755,000 from $479,000.
Pro forma net income per share increased to $0.16 for the second quarter of 1997 from a pro forma net income per share of $0.11 for the comparable period in 1996.

Shells has opened four new restaurants to date in 1997 ands plans to open about six to eight additional new restaurants during the second half of 1997 in the Florida and Midwest markets. The actual number of new restaurant openings will depend upon several factors including the Company's ability to execute satisfactory leases, the company said.
Shells currently manages and operates 35 full service, mid-priced casual dining seafood restaurants.
